# sustain_alert_contact (Resource)

An address alerts are emailed to once it's confirmed: one of the workspace's people, or another address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Emailed to confirm before any alert reaches it.
resource "sustain_alert_contact" "ops" {
  email = "ops@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String)
- `user_id` (String) For one of the workspace's people, their account, whose address it is; null for any other address.
- `weekly_report` (Boolean) Whether they get the weekly report, once confirmed: on unless they or an Admin turned it off.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8601 time in UTC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id in Sustain, as its page in the console, or its API, gives it.
terraform import sustain_alert_contact.ops <id>
```
